title: The 84 Month Car Loan Calculation
hook_text: THAT 84 MONTH CAR LOAN DOUBLES YOUR INTEREST

beats.say: Extending your car loan to 84 months feels smart because the monthly payment drops.
beats.visual: A sleek modern car parked alone in a dimly lit concrete parking garage, moody shadows, cinematic wide shot.

beats.say: But it's a trap built on simple math that banks love.
beats.visual: Close-up of a fountain pen signing a stack of crisp white loan papers on a dark wooden desk.

beats.say: You're stretching a short term asset over a very long timeline.
beats.visual: A mechanical desk calendar flipping pages rapidly in soft focus, warm interior lighting.

beats.say: Let's look at the actual numbers behind that choice.
beats.visual: A glowing desk lamp casting a sharp circle of light on an empty wooden table, moody atmosphere.

beats.say: When you drag a loan out that long, the total interest doubles.
beats.visual: A heavy metal vault door slowly swinging shut in a dark, secure bank vault, dramatic side lighting.

beats.say: Meanwhile, the car itself loses value every single day.
beats.visual: A vintage pocket watch resting on a cold stone surface, macro lens, shallow depth of field.

beats.say: You're paying top dollar for a depreciating metal box.
beats.visual: Raindrops sliding down a large office window overlooking a blurred, distant city skyline at dusk.

beats.say: That extra interest could have grown in an index fund instead.
beats.visual: A single green sprout pushing up through dark, rich soil, morning sunlight, macro shot.

beats.say: Remember, at 8% a year, money doubles over time if you let it work.
beats.visual: A classic hourglass resting on a dark slate table, sand slowly falling through the center.

beats.say: Don't trade your financial future for a slightly lower monthly bill.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person walking away down a long, empty corridor toward a bright exit, dramatic shadows.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: A glowing neon exit sign mounted on a dark brick wall, moody cinematic framing.

caption: The math behind long car loans hurts your net worth. #personalfinance #moneytips #wealthbuilding #carloans #smartmoney
description: Exposing how extending a car loan to 84 months doubles your total interest paid on a depreciating asset.
first_comment: What's the longest car loan term you've ever seen offered?

facts.claim: Rule of 72: at 8% money doubles every 9 years
